name: safe-zone-monitor
description: Safe Zone Monitor: Edge AI danger-zone alerts (monorepo for TypeScript apps)

scripts.api:generate: npm run openapi:generate -w apps/backend && npm run generate -w packages/api-types
scripts.cam: uv run --directory apps/edge-ai yolo predict model=models/yolo11n.pt source=0 classes=0 conf=0.5 device=cpu imgsz=640 show=True
scripts.cam:save: uv run --directory apps/edge-ai yolo predict model=models/yolo11n.pt source=0 classes=0 conf=0.5 device=cpu imgsz=640 show=True save=True
